name: Brand Content System
purpose: Turn approved brand canon into a repeatable content operating system — pillars traced to strategy, format/channel rules, production cadence and reusable templates — for ongoing content production.
triggers: ongoing/recurring content production is needed, not a single deliverable
brand strategy and verbal identity (or a compiled brand book) already exist and are approved
a team needs a structure that keeps producing on-strategy content repeatably
non_triggers: a single social caption, post, or one-off creative deliverable
defining brand positioning, promise or audience
a plain editorial calendar with no pillar/format/measurement logic behind it
optional_inputs: production constraints (team size, cadence capacity, budget, tooling)
quality_gates: every pillar traces to a named line in brand strategy or verbal identity
every format is repeatable and has a per-channel variant where more than one channel is in scope
cadence is arithmetic-backed or explicitly flagged capacity_unknown
measurement model never presents a reach/view/impression metric as a revenue or conversion signal
CTA/funnel logic is explicit per pillar, not implied
stop_conditions: all five required artifacts produced, every pillar traced to strategy, cadence resolved or flagged -> COMPLETE
brand strategy/verbal identity missing or still draft/unapproved -> BLOCKED, name exactly what must be approved/supplied first
never present pillars as a generic content checklist detachable from this brand's strategy
